description: This file contains unit tests for the ExternalAssetOwnersWriteServiceImpl class, focusing on operations related to external asset owner transfers such as sale, buyback, and validation of transfer states. It tests behaviors like handling delayed settlements, transfer status validations, exception cases, and creation of transfer records.

classes.name: ExternalAssetOwnersWriteServiceTest
classes.description: Unit tests class for ExternalAssetOwnersWriteServiceImpl, testing various scenarios for external asset owner transfer operations including sale, buyback, validation, and exception cases.

classes.name: TestContext
classes.description: Inner static class to encapsulate mocks, test data, and helper methods for unit tests.

methods.name: testIntermediarySaleLoanByLoanIdHappyPath
methods.description: Tests the happy path for intermediary sale of a loan by loan id, ensuring transfer is created with correct values.

methods.name: testIntermediarySaleLoanByLoanIdDelayedSettlementIsNotEnabled
methods.description: Tests that an exception is thrown if delayed settlement is not enabled when attempting an intermediary sale.

methods.name: testValidateEffectiveTransferForIntermediarySale
methods.description: Validates that the effective transfer for intermediary sale is correct, or fails with appropriate message based on transfer state.

methods.name: testValidateValidActiveLoanStatus
methods.description: Checks that a loan with valid active status passes the sale process.

methods.name: testValidateInvalidActiveLoanStatus
methods.description: Ensures that invalid active loan statuses cause an exception with appropriate message.

methods.name: testValidateValidDelayedSettlementLoanStatus
methods.description: Verifies valid delayed settlement loan statuses allow sale operation.

methods.name: testValidateInvalidDelayedSettlementLoanStatus
methods.description: Checks that invalid delayed settlement statuses cause a transfer exception.

methods.name: verifyWhenLoanSaleIsInitiatedThenAssetOwnerTransferIsCreated
methods.description: Confirms that initiating a loan sale creates the correct asset owner transfer record with expected values.

methods.name: validateSettlementDateInThePastTest
methods.description: Ensures that a settlement date in the past causes an exception.

methods.name: verifyWhenLoanSaleIsInitiatedWithoutOwnerThenAssetOwnerTransferIsCreated
methods.description: Tests creation of asset owner transfer when no owner exists, with delayed settlement disabled.

methods.name: verifyWhenLoanIsNotFoundThenExceptionIsThrown
methods.description: Checks that a missing loan results in a LoanNotFoundException.

methods.name: verifyWhenFieldValueInvalidThenExceptionIsThrown
methods.description: Tests validation failures for input fields, such as null or overly long strings.

methods.name: verifyWhenTransferExternalIdExistsThenExceptionIsThrown
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown if a transfer with the same external ID already exists.

methods.name: verifyWhenTooManyEffectiveTransfersThenExceptionIsThrown
methods.description: Tests that too many effective transfer records cause an exception.

methods.name: verifyWhenNoEffectiveTransfersWithDelayedSettlementThenExceptionIsThrown
methods.description: Checks that absence of effective transfer records with delayed settlement enabled results in an exception.

methods.name: verifyWhenInvalidTransferStatusThenExceptionIsThrown
methods.description: Ensures invalid transfer statuses lead to exceptions with correct messages.

methods.name: buybackLoanByLoanIdWhenDelaySettlementEnabledSuccess
methods.description: Tests successful buyback process with delay settlement enabled, resulting in correct transfer creation.

methods.name: buybackLoanByLoanIdWhenDelaySettlementEnabledFailure
methods.description: Verifies exceptions thrown if buyback process fails due to invalid transfer states.
